description.en: Three weeks before Easter. Granny Maggie and Poppy pick daffodils, and every mum gets flowers, a card and breakfast in bed.
description.sl: Tri tedne pred veliko nočjo. Babica Maggie in Poppy trgata narcise, vsaka mama pa dobi rože, voščilnico in zajtrk v postelji.
description.it: Tre settimane prima di Pasqua. Nonna Maggie e Poppy raccolgono i narcisi, e ogni mamma riceve fiori, un biglietto e la colazione a letto.
description.de: Drei Wochen vor Ostern. Oma Maggie und Poppy pflücken Osterglocken, und jede Mama bekommt Blumen, eine Karte und Frühstück im Bett.

words.example_it: La mia mamma è la migliore!
words.note: British Mum, American Mom. With a capital M when you talk to her: “Thanks, Mum!”
words.note_sl: Britansko Mum, ameriško Mom. Z veliko začetnico, ko jo ogovoriš: »Thanks, Mum!«
words.note_it: In inglese britannico Mum, in americano Mom. Con la maiuscola quando le parli: «Thanks, Mum!»
words.note_de: Britisch Mum, amerikanisch Mom. Großgeschrieben, wenn man sie anspricht: „Thanks, Mum!“

words.example_en: Wordsworth wrote a poem about daffodils.
words.example_sl: Wordsworth je napisal pesem o narcisah.
words.example_it: Wordsworth ha scritto una poesia sui narcisi.
words.example_de: Wordsworth hat ein Gedicht über Osterglocken geschrieben.
words.note: Wordsworth saw them by Ullswater: “I wandered lonely as a cloud …”
words.note_sl: Wordsworth jih je videl ob jezeru Ullswater: »I wandered lonely as a cloud …«
words.note_it: Wordsworth li ha visti vicino al lago Ullswater: «I wandered lonely as a cloud…»
words.note_de: Wordsworth sah sie am See Ullswater: „I wandered lonely as a cloud …“

words.example_en: Poppy is making a card for her mum.
words.example_it: Poppy sta facendo un biglietto per la sua mamma.
words.example_de: Poppy bastelt eine Karte für ihre Mama.

words.example_en: Granny Maggie gets a big bunch of flowers.
words.example_it: Nonna Maggie riceve un grande mazzo di fiori.
words.example_de: Oma Maggie bekommt einen großen Blumenstrauß.

words.example_en: Let's pick flowers in the garden.
words.example_de: Lass uns im Garten Blumen pflücken.
words.note: to pick also means to choose: “Pick a card!”
words.note_sl: to pick pomeni tudi izbrati: »Pick a card!« (Izberi karto!)
words.note_it: to pick vuol dire anche scegliere: «Pick a card!» (Scegli una carta!)
words.note_de: to pick heißt auch auswählen: „Pick a card!“ (Such dir eine Karte aus!)

words.example_en: On Mothering Sunday Mum gets breakfast in bed.
words.example_sl: Na materinski dan mama dobi zajtrk v postelji.
words.example_it: Per la festa della mamma, la mamma fa colazione a letto.
words.example_de: Am Muttertag bekommt Mama Frühstück im Bett.
words.note: in bed, at home, at school: no “the”.
words.note_sl: in bed, at home, at school: brez »the«.
words.note_it: in bed, at home, at school: senza «the».
words.note_de: in bed, at home, at school: ohne „the“.

words.example_en: Give your mum a big hug!
words.example_it: Dai un grande abbraccio alla tua mamma!

words.example_en: In spring the lambs are born.
words.example_de: Im Frühling kommen die Lämmer zur Welt.
